name: panda_pick_place
description: Pick up the selected visible graspable object and place it in the observed basket using pi05. Bind target and on from current Ego State. No automatic retry; reset after rejected policy motion.
requires: Body libero-panda supports libero_pick_place; args.target is a fresh graspable object id and args.on is a fresh basket id in the current Ego State; gripper is empty.
ensures: Returns succeeded/achieved/confirmed only after observed grasp, release in the basket, withdrawal and stable placement, followed by confirmed stopping; otherwise throws the terminal result.

parameters.target: Current Ego-State id of the selected graspable object
parameters.on: Current Ego-State id of the destination basket
